Pretty big task for a novice. You're talking about an ecommerce site, with a shopping cart, and the backend DB for loading and listing product. I would try the established merchant sites, like Etsy, to get started and build some revenue. Once the business gets off the ground, you can revisit the whole website topic.

I would like for you and your friend to fully understand that it's practically impossible to make a living from handmade jewelry if you're living in the first world. So, at most, look at it like a hobby that can pay for the materials.

Web dev here and I do this all the time. (simple to setup, hard to maintain and make moneys)

step 1 Rent a server and get a domain name. I use IXwebhosting and they are great. its like 8.00 a month and works out to about 100.00 a year all in (shared server space and domain name registration are TWO different costs)

Step 2 Then load up Wordpress with woocommerce. Both are free and used by millions of people. It's pretty easy, but you have to be at least slightly technical.

All this can be done in just an hour or so.

BUT.....

Now comes the fun part. Step 3 You have to take catalog photos (real nice ones) and write descriptions, set up shipping options and setup your payment gatewaysand generally configure the system. Then figure out internally how you are going to handle shipping (once a day, once ever three days? on Tuesdays and Thursdays?) how to handle taxes, etc. this part can take a few days or stretch into weeks.

THEN the really fun part.
Part 4 Marketing and SEO/social media. This takes weeks and months and is key to having any sort of real revenue stream. These skills are sciences in themselfs and I charge 65.00+ an hour to do it, so that gives you an idea as to the level of expertise and effort that goes into this portion of the job.

My advice: Setup on Etsy/ebay to get going. (and you will still have to do step 4 each day to stand out as Etsy is crowded with this sort of thing) If and when you get a revenue stream, then think about a stand alone website.
